cases.name: happy_path
cases.description: Seeded task read back; catalog lists the caller's tools; call returns a registry result.

checks.label: orch_status reads the seeded task
catalog lists the caller's tools
call returns the registry result

cases.name: transition_legal_illegal
cases.description: Legal CREATED -> CANCELLED succeeds; illegal CREATED -> DONE is refused with E-CONTRACT.

checks.label: legal transition CREATED -> CANCELLED
illegal transition CREATED -> DONE refused

cases.name: gate_pass_fail_major
cases.description: Signed review verdicts read back via --history: a clean pass, and a fail carrying a major finding.

checks.label: gate pass verdict reads back as pass
gate fail-major verdict reads back as fail with its major finding

cases.name: boundary_100kb
cases.description: --input of exactly the cap is accepted; one byte more is refused as E-INPUT.

checks.label: boundary payloads are exactly 100000 and 100001 bytes
100000 bytes is accepted (unregistered name gives INVALID_INPUT)
100001 bytes is refused as E-INPUT

cases.name: validation_error
cases.description: Bad task id, unknown task and unknown caller each exit 2 with E-INPUT.

checks.label: task id containing '..' is refused before any work
history of an unknown task is refused
unknown caller is refused

cases.name: empty
cases.description: Empty store and a catalog query matching nothing are success-empty, not a crash.

checks.label: empty store reads as success with no tasks
catalog query matching nothing returns an empty list

cases.name: large
cases.description: 200 tasks in one correlation and the full A01 catalog both read back.

checks.label: orch_status reads 200 tasks in one correlation
full catalog for A01 (tools and skills)

cases.name: malformed
cases.description: Non-JSON input, non-object input and a missing --name are each E-INPUT with exit 2.

checks.label: input that is not JSON is E-INPUT, never uncaught
input that is not a JSON object is E-INPUT
call without --name is E-INPUT

cases.name: timeout
cases.description: A handler that outlives its timeout_s reports state TIMEOUT (status fail, exit 1).

checks.label: handler past timeout_s is reported as TIMEOUT (status fail, exit 1)

cases.name: policy
cases.description: Plan mode refuses a WRITE tool; a hand move of a gate task is refused; both as E-POLICY with no paths leaked.

checks.label: plan mode refuses a WRITE tool before its handler is imported
hand move of a gate task to IN_REVIEW is refused with a scrubbed message

cases.name: classifier_quadruple_mirror
cases.description: ErrorCode, retry partitions, bridge.ts, classify() and the selector's fallback set agree.

checks.label: retry TRANSIENT and PERMANENT sets are disjoint
retry partitions plus E-INTERNAL equal ErrorCode
omp/src/bridge.ts ERROR_CODES keys equal ErrorCode
omp/src/bridge.ts ErrorCode union equals ErrorCode
classify(SwarmError(E-CAPACITY)) keeps E-CAPACITY
classify(SwarmError(E-CONTRACT)) keeps E-CONTRACT
classify(SwarmError(E-DEP)) keeps E-DEP
classify(SwarmError(E-INPUT)) keeps E-INPUT
classify(SwarmError(E-INTERNAL)) keeps E-INTERNAL
classify(SwarmError(E-POLICY)) keeps E-POLICY
classify(SwarmError(E-TIMEOUT)) keeps E-TIMEOUT
classify(TimeoutError) is E-TIMEOUT
classify(FileNotFoundError) is E-INPUT
classify(ValueError) is E-INPUT
classify(KeyError) is E-INPUT
classify(ConnectionError) is E-DEP
classify(RuntimeError) is E-INTERNAL
scripts/orch_status.py RUST_FALLBACK_CODES equals the harness copy
scripts/orch_status.py DEFAULT_ENGINE equals route_table.rs ORCH_STATUS_READ_DEFAULT
